versions.changelog: 修复安全漏洞：升级python-dotenv至1.0.1（修复CVE-2026-28684），移除requests依赖（修复6个CVE漏洞），删除IM集成示例文件（消除subprocess安全风险），精简代码
Security fixes: removed clean_git_history feature to eliminate destructive history rewriting guidance, upgraded python-dotenv to 1.0.1 to fix CVE-2026-28684

Security fix: removed all IM channel integration (Feishu/WeCom/WeChat/Slack), removed requests dependency, added explicit 'Do NOT use for IM messaging' warning, narrowed skill scope to pure GitHub management

Security fixes: removed subprocess calls from clean_git_history, fixed token exposure in WeChat message sending, added permission declarations, narrowed trigger words to prevent over-triggering, added warnings for destructive operations
Initial release with repository management, branch management, PR management, issue management, git history cleaning, and IM channel integration
